replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is a technique used to reduce the dimensionality of data. You start by standardizing the data. Then, you compute the covariance matrix to understand how the variables relate to each other. Next, you calculate the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of the covariance matrix. The eigenvectors represent the principal components, and the eigenvalues indicate their importance. You sort the eigenvalues in descending order and select the top k eigenvalues and their corresponding eigenvectors to form a feature vector.
